correctness.rationale: The n+1 uniform spacings are Dirichlet(1,...,1) after scaling by L; origin inclusion means all circular gaps below pi. Exterior gap 2pi-L+u+v<pi iff u+v<delta and an internal long-gap event is an O((delta/L)^n) correction, negligible relative to delta^2 for n>=3. Joint extrema density n(n-1)(L-u-v)^(n-2)/L^n gives conditional uniform triangle via density and Scheffe. In the c/n regime, n/L-scaled endpoint slacks have density (n-1)/n(1-(a+b)/n)^(n-2), tending in L1 to independent Exp(1); restriction a+b<c gives truncated-gamma normalization 1-(1+c)e^-c. Internal max gaps large enough to threaten nearest chord have probability decaying exponentially, whereas extreme-chord clearance vanishes; clearance chord equals sin((delta-u-v)/2) giving beta(1,2) and Z_c=(c-E1-E2)_+/2. The submitted proof correctly restricts total variation to endpoint pairs (not the singularly supported joint distance-mark triples). Computed special p_3(2pi)=1/4, p_4(1.25pi)=.176 match exact formula.
